- Tue 2026-10-12 10:00–11:00 (procurement + AE + SE)
- Wed 2026-10-13 08:30–09:30 (security deep-dive with SE + customer sec)
- Thu 2026-10-14 14:00–15:00 (backup — split sessions if needed)

Thanks — I’ll wait for availability and can send calendar holds once confirmed.

Hi Jonas — thanks for sending.

Quick context from our side: procurement has a vendor intake window the week of Oct 11 but legal is OOO on Oct 12 and 13, and security is requesting an earlier pre-screen before any contract conversation. Our constraints:

- Procurement preferred days: Mon Oct 11 or Fri Oct 15 (mornings work best)
- Security (Mike) wants a 30–45 minute technical pre-screen before procurement sign-off — ideally earlier in the week (Mon/Tue morning)
- We cannot do Wed Oct 13 afternoon due to an internal audit

Can you do a quick two-part approach: 1) security pre-screen with your SE (30–45m), 2) procurement intake (45–60m) with AE + legal? If so, please propose exact times.

Also, can you share your SOC 2 summary and any architectural constraints (VPC peering requirements, TLS endpoints)? Procurement will log those in the intake form.

—Aisha

1) Security pre-screen (30–45m) with Dylan (SE) + Cypher sec — capture high-level network/connectivity + data residency constraints.
2) Procurement intake (45–60m) with AE + procurement + legal (if available) to walk the intake form and timeline.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Security pre-screen: Mon Oct 11 09:30–10:15 OR Tue Oct 12 08:30–09:15
- Procurement intake: Mon Oct 11 11:00–12:00 OR Tue Oct 12 10:00–11:00

Dylan, can you confirm availability for the pre-screen on those times? Aisha, if neither Monday nor Tuesday works, we can move the procurement intake to Fri Oct 15 morning.

I’ll draft a mutual action plan after we lock the times and will loop legal if Aisha confirms.

Thanks — Priyom
